verdict.rationale: Cloudflare offers Workers KV for globally distributed key-value storage and Queues for job/task processing (docs-4, docs-9), and community reports confirm developers using KV successfully for production caching (comm-3). However, none of the evidence indicates Redis protocol compatibility — KV has a different API/semantics, and community feedback notes lock-in concerns tied to KV/D1's proprietary nature (comm-10), meaning it satisfies the caching/queue need but not the 'Redis-compatible' requirement.
